title: Flavanol Consumption in Healthy Men Preserves Integrity of Immunological-Endothelial Barrier Cell Functions: Nutri(epi)genomic Analysis.
authors: Milenkovic, Dragan; Rodriguez-Mateos, Ana; Lucosz, Margarete; Istas, Geoffrey; Declerck, Ken; Sansone, Roberto; Deenen, Rene; Kohrer, Karl; Corral-Jara, Karla Fabiola; Altschmied, Joachim; Haendeler, Judith; Kelm, Malte; Berghe, Wim Vanden; Heiss, Christian
one_liner_zh: 该研究分析可可黄烷醇摄入对健康男性免疫-内皮屏障功能的营养表观基因组影响，虽含转录因子结合预测，但核心为饮食干预的基因表达与甲基化分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: SCOPE: While cocoa flavanol (CF) consumption improves cardiovascular risk biomarkers, molecular mechanisms underlying their protective effects are not understood. OBJECTIVE: To investigate nutri(epi)genomic effects of CF and identify regulatory networks potential mediating vascular health benefits. METHODS AND RESULTS: Twenty healthy middle-aged men consume CF (bi-daily 450 mg) or control drinks for 1 month. Microarray analysis identifies 2235 differentially expressed genes (DEG) involved in processes regulating immune response, cell adhesion, or cytoskeleton organization. Distinct patterns of DEG correlate with CF-related changes in endothelial function, arterial stiffness, and blood pressure. DEG profile negatively correlates with expression profiles of cardiovascular disease patients. CF modulated DNA methylation profile of genes implicates in cell adhesion, actin cytoskeleton organization, or cell signaling. In silico docking analyses indicate that CF metabolites have the potential of binding to cell signaling proteins and transcription factors. Incubation of plasma obtained after CF consumption decrease monocyte to endothelial adhesion and dose-dependently increase nitric oxide-dependent chemotaxis of circulating angiogenic cells further validating the biological functions of CF metabolites. CONCLUSION: In healthy humans, CF consumption may mediate vascular protective effects by modulating gene expression and DNA methylation towards a cardiovascular protective effect, in agreement with clinical results, by preserving integrity of immunological-endothelial barrier functions.
abstract_zh: 范围：虽然可可黄烷醇（CF）的摄入能改善心血管风险生物标志物，但其保护作用背后的分子机制尚不清楚。目的：研究CF的营养（表观）基因组效应，并识别可能介导血管健康益处的调控网络。方法与结果：20名健康中年男性连续1个月每日两次摄入CF（450毫克）或对照饮料。微阵列分析识别出2235个差异表达基因（DEG），涉及调节免疫反应、细胞粘附或细胞骨架组织的进程。DEG的不同模式与CF相关的内皮功能、动脉硬度和血压变化相关。DEG谱与心血管疾病患者的表达谱呈负相关。CF调节了涉及细胞粘附、肌动蛋白细胞骨架组织或细胞信号传导的基因的DNA甲基化谱。计算机模拟对接分析表明，CF代谢物具有结合细胞信号蛋白和转录因子的潜力。摄入CF后获得的血浆孵育可减少单核细胞与内皮的粘附，并剂量依赖性地增加一氧化氮依赖性循环血管生成细胞的趋化性，进一步验证了CF代谢物的生物学功能。结论：在健康人群中，CF摄入可能通过调节基因表达和DNA甲基化朝向心血管保护效应，介导血管保护作用，这与临床结果一致，通过保持免疫-内皮屏障功能的完整性。
